replies.text:
That message is not something I can verify, but I can tell you this: Fibrapunto never asks you to update card details by clicking a link in a text or email. This has the pattern of a phishing scam. I would not click the link.

If you want to check whether your account really has a payment issue, I can look that up directly. Could you give me your contract number, in the format FP-YYYY-NNNNNN?

And a general reminder: never enter your card number, bank details, or password through a link like that.
